profile.status: Available for Select Contracts & Engineering Roles
about: I am an engineer focused on the intersection of infrastructure reliability, automated deployment, and full-stack measurement pipelines.

Rather than relying on bloated frameworks and guesswork, I build systems designed for determinism: reproducible server state through SaltStack and Docker, fast and resilient ingress through Nginx and HAProxy, and server-side tracking pipelines (GTM, GA4, Meta CAPI) that preserve conversion data through browser cookie crackdowns.

This portfolio itself is compiled directly in Rust using Maud macros with inlined critical CSS, delivering a single-pass ~20KB payload with zero render-blocking JavaScript and sub-30ms first contentful paint.

projects.title: Full-Stack Ad-Ops & Attribution Tracking Pipeline
projects.headline: Server-side GTM + GA4 + Meta CAPI pipeline turning raw click traffic into verified ROAS telemetry.
projects.problem: Client-side tracking was suffering from 25-40% signal loss due to ad-blockers, Safari ITP cookie expiration, and iOS privacy controls, causing degraded ad optimization and blind ad spend.
projects.solution: Architected a dual-delivery tracking pipeline: client dataLayer feeds a custom Server-Side GTM proxy on a custom subdomain. Event data is deduplicated with unique Event IDs and dispatched directly to Meta Conversions API and GA4 Measurement Protocol, backed by Looker Studio reports.

projects.title: High-Availability E-Commerce & CMS Cloud Platform
projects.headline: Decoupled headless React frontend with WooCommerce backend provisioned via wp-saltstack.
projects.problem: Monolithic WordPress instances suffered severe latency spikes during sales spikes and lacked automated, reproducible provisioning across bare-metal and cloud servers.
projects.solution: Decoupled the architecture: high-speed React storefront communicating via cached REST endpoints to a WooCommerce engine. Servers are provisioned idempotently with SaltStack (wp-saltstack) behind HAProxy/Nginx load balancing with automatic SSL renewal.

projects.title: Domain-Specific Knowledge Base with RAG
projects.headline: Retrieval-augmented chatbot ensuring source-verified, hallucination-free technical responses.
projects.problem: Generic LLMs frequently hallucinated API signatures and company-specific operational procedures when queried by technical users.
projects.solution: Built a Python FastAPI service that ingests documentation markdown, generates embeddings into a vector store, performs semantic top-k retrieval with reranking, and injects verified source snippets into the prompt context.

projects.title: Rust Compile-Time Zero-Overhead Portfolio Engine
projects.headline: Maud macro pre-renderer producing a single-pass ~20KB payload with zero initial JS execution.
projects.problem: Modern developer portfolios bloated with 1MB+ of React/Next.js JS bundles, taking 800ms+ on mobile devices and requiring complex runtime servers for simple static portfolios.
projects.solution: Engineered a native Rust CLI compiler that type-checks data schemas with Serde and renders inlined critical CSS with Maud macros. Result: 100/100 Lighthouse performance, sub-30ms edge paint, and zero client hydration penalty.
